The Opportunity:
Maitland City Council's Pathways program is a fantastic way to kick-start your career and gain professional experience in local government!
Commencing in January 2027, for a period of two years, we have two exciting opportunities for Graduate Civil Engineers to join our organisation.
In this role, you will undertake a graduate program developed specifically for you, giving you exposure to a range of civil engineering functions for the investigation and delivery of civil and recreation infrastructure projects undertaken by Council. These duties are going to help you develop a solid foundation to your civil engineering career.
About you:
To be successful in this role you will possess:
- Degree level qualifications in Civil engineering in the previous two years or completion of degree by January 2027
- Contemporary industry knowledge of civil engineering areas
- Experience and understanding in project support and the research, analysis and presentation of information
- Current Class C driver's licence
Benefits:
This Graduate position is temporary full time (two-year contract) with a commencing salary of $1,414.58 weekly, plus 12% superannuation. Graduates will also have access to Council's great staff benefits including:
- Flexible work arrangements
- One extra week of "My Leave" a year (to use how you like!)
- Ongoing training and development
- Fitness Passport
- Healthy Employee Program
To apply:
To apply for this opportunity, please click 'Apply Now' and submit your resume and cover letter.
Questions:
To viw the role charter click 'Apply Now'. If after reading the role charter you have any questions, please contact the recruitment team at Recruitment@maitland.nsw.gov.au
More information regarding Council's Pathways Program can be viewed via https://www.maitland.nsw.gov.au/pathways-program.
Applications close: Sunday 25th October 2027
Only candidates with current Australian work rights (Australian citizens, permanent residents, NZ citizens with a current passport, valid work visa) will be considered.
What happens next?
Once applications close, we will review all candidates' details against the role requirements and will be back in touch with you to advise the status of your application.
Please note, prior to an offer of employment being made, recommended candidates will be required to undertake a medical assessment (including drug and alcohol testing). Council also completes a range of other pre-employment checks which may include reference checks, psychometric testing or a criminal history check. For more information about the recruitment process, visit the "Jobs at Council" page on our website.
Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion
Maitland City Council is dedicated to providing a workplace that is inclusive and supportive and is reflective of the diverse community we serve. We support equal opportunities for all employees, and encourage applications from people from all cultures, nationalities, identities, and abilities. We believe all employees have the right to feel valued, respected and heard. If you have any special considerations or accessibility requirements, please let us know in the recruitment process how we are able to meet your needs.
 If you require special assistance, or have any questions about the recruitment process please contact us for a confidential conversation (Recruitment@maitland.nsw.gov.au)

- Work closely with experienced engineers in our West Perth office

candidates.content_text:
Kickstart Your Career in Engineering Drafting!
Ready to turn your interest in design and engineering into a career?
Whether you’re finishing Year 12, recently left school or studying Civil Drafting at TAFE, this is your opportunity to get started in the engineering industry.
STP Consultants is looking for an enthusiastic Junior Civil Draftsperson to join our growing Brisbane team. You’ll work alongside experienced civil engineers and drafters, gain hands-on experience and learn how the drawings you create become part of real projects across Queensland.
You don’t need years of experience. We’re looking for someone with the right attitude, curiosity and willingness to learn.
Why you’ll love working here
Start building your career
Get hands-on experience from day one and develop practical civil drafting skills while learning from experienced engineers and drafters.
Work on real projects
Go beyond the classroom and see how civil engineering projects come together. You’ll contribute to drawings and documentation used throughout projects from concept and design through to delivery.
Learn from experienced people
Ask questions, share ideas and learn from people who genuinely want to help you develop. You’ll receive guidance and mentoring as your skills and confidence grow.
Be part of a great team
Join a close-knit, collaborative team where people support each other, work together and enjoy what they do.
Work in Fortitude Valley
Our Brisbane office is in the heart of Fortitude Valley, close to public transport, cafés, restaurants and everything the city has to offer.
The Opportunity 
As you develop your skills, you’ll have the opportunity to:
- Assist with preparing civil drawings, plans and project documentation.
- Work with engineers and experienced drafters to produce clear, accurate and high-quality drawings.
- Learn industry standards, guidelines and best-practice drafting processes.
- Develop your understanding of how civil engineering projects are designed and delivered.
- Participate in project discussions and meetings to build your understanding of project requirements.
- Carry out basic drawing and documentation checks with guidance from experienced team members.
- Take on more responsibility as your skills and confidence develop.
About you:
You could be a great fit if you are:
- A Year 12 student, recent school leaver or currently studying Civil Drafting at TAFE.
- Genuinely interested in civil drafting, design and engineering.
- Curious and keen to learn new skills.
- Detail-oriented and take pride in producing accurate work.
- A good communicator who is comfortable asking questions and taking feedback.
- Reliable, organized and willing to have a go at new challenges.
- Someone who enjoys working with others and being part of a team.
- An Australian Citizen or Permanent Resident.
Most importantly, bring your enthusiasm and willingness to learn. We’ll help you turn it into a career.
What’s in it for you?
- 
Career development: Build your skills through hands-on experience, mentoring and ongoing professional development.
- 
Flexibility: Enjoy a 9-day fortnight, flexible working hours and the option to purchase additional leave.
- 
Competitive remuneration: A package that reflects your experience and contribution.
- 
Recognition and rewards: Employee referral rewards and recognition programs.
- 
Great culture: Work with supportive people in a friendly, collaborative environment, with regular team and social events.
- 
Wellbeing support: Access to a confidential Employee Assistance Program.
- 
Long-term opportunity: Build your career with an established, Australian-owned engineering consultancy.
About STP Consultants 
For more than 20 years, STP Consultants has been helping shape communities across Queensland. We’re a privately owned, multidisciplinary engineering consultancy, bringing together expertise across Civil, Structural, Mechanical, Electrical, Hydraulic, Fire and Seismic engineering. 
Our teams work on a diverse range of projects across Queensland, giving you the opportunity to learn from experienced professionals and see the many different paths an engineering career can take.
Our values of Potential, Respect, Integrity, Deliver and Engage shape the way we work with our clients and with each other.
We’re proud of our approachable leaders, supportive team environment and commitment to developing people and delivering quality engineering outcomes.
Ready to get started?  
If you’re looking for more than just a first job and want to build a career in engineering, we’d love to hear from you.
Click Apply and send us your Resume and Cover Letter.
In your cover letter, tell us:
1. Why you’re interested in starting a career in civil drafting.  2. What interests you about joining STP Consultants.
STP Consultants is an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and welcome applications from all backgrounds.

candidates.content_text:
Why our People Choose Quickway
At the heart of our business are our greatest assets, our people, our culture and our core values of honesty, openness and fairness.
At Quickway, we are committed to nurturing talent and developing people. As we grow, we ensure that our people and their skills grow with us. Working with us, there are often opportunities to learn and build on your experience and we actively encourage professional development. We believe in building our people so that they can build Australia's future.
We partner with our clients and teams to deliver without compromising on our core values. We recognise and reward the efforts and achievements of our people.
Start Your Civil Engineering Career with Quickway
Quickway is a leading civil infrastructure contractor delivering projects across Roads & Bridges, Concrete Structures, Rail, Utilities, Communications, Electrical and Water Infrastructure throughout NSW and QLD.
We are seeking an enthusiastic Undergraduate Civil Engineer to join our team based at our Burleigh Waters Project in Queensland.
This opportunity is ideal for a 3rd or 4th year Civil Engineering student looking to gain practical, hands-on experience while completing their degree. Whether you are seeking your first engineering role, vocational placement or looking to gain exposure to live civil construction projects, we would love to hear from you.
No prior industry experience is required. We are looking for someone with a positive attitude, willingness to learn and genuine interest in building a career in civil engineering.
About the Role
You will be part of the project team delivering the Cassowary Drive Bridge Replacement project, which has just kicked off, and will run through to completion in the second half of 2027. The project is a $18 million infrastructure project delivering a new flood-resilient bridge and improved transport connectivity for the growing southern Gold Coast community. Working alongside experienced Project Engineers, Site Supervisors and Project Managers, you will gain exposure to all aspects of project delivery including:
- Site-based engineering and construction activities
- Quality assurance and project documentation
- Construction methodologies and planning
- Safety and environmental compliance
- Subcontractor coordination
- Site inspections and reporting
- Quantity tracking and progress monitoring
- Survey and set out activities
- Contract administration and project controls
This is a hands-on role that will provide valuable exposure to the civil construction industry while allowing you to continue your university studies.
What You Will Bring
Essential
- Currently studying a Bachelor of Civil Engineering.
- In your 3rd or 4th year of study.
- Ability to travel to our Burleigh Waters project site.
- Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
- Positive attitude and willingness to learn.
- Full working rights in Australia with the intention of pursuing a long-term career in Australia.
- A genuine interest in civil construction and infrastructure projects.
Desirable
- Current Driver's Licence.
- Previous construction, labouring or site-based experience.
- Completion of vocational placement or internship programs.
- White Card.
What We Offer
- Flexible work arrangements to support university commitments.
- Approximately 3 days per week with additional hours available during semester breaks and project requirements.
- Exposure to major civil infrastructure projects.
- Mentoring from experienced industry professionals.
- Practical experience that complements your university studies.
- Opportunity to transition into a Graduate Engineer role upon completion of your degree.
- Supportive team culture focused on learning and development.
 If you are looking to gain real-world engineering experience, work alongside experienced professionals and build a long-term career in civil construction, we would love to hear from you.   Apply now or contact Suzi Dimech at suzid@quickway.com.au for further information.

Help shape the future of transport infrastructure across Southeast Queensland.

- Contribute to innovative, practical and sustainable infrastructure solutions

- Strong technical skills and attention to detail
- Ability to work collaboratively within a multidisciplinary team

They are the ones who can create infrastructure that makes life better for people and the planet. That is our purpose. Bringing ideas to life. This is The Aurecon Way. 
Ready for your next adventure? 
If this sounds like your next step, we'd love to hear from you. We value diverse experiences and welcome applications for part-time or flexible working arrangements.

Build More. Build Your Career.
Ready to kick-start your engineering career on some of Southeast Queensland’s most exciting infrastructure projects?
Seymour Whyte's Graduate Program gives ambitious engineering graduates the opportunity to work on major projects, take on real responsibility from day one, and develop the technical, commercial and leadership skills needed for a successful career in construction.
Through our structured two-year development program, you'll gain hands-on experience across major civil infrastructure projects, work alongside industry leaders, receive dedicated mentoring and build the skills and confidence to accelerate your career.  You'll be trusted with real responsibility, supported to grow and given the opportunity to make a genuine impact while helping deliver infrastructure that connects communities.
About the Project
We have an exciting opportunity for a Graduate Civil Engineer to join our Beerburrum to Nambour (B2N) Rail Upgrade project.
This a major infrastructure project transforming the North Coast Line on the Sunshine Coast. The project includes rail duplication, new and upgraded transport infrastructure, improved road overpasses and enhanced signalling systems, all aimed at increasing capacity and reliability across the network. Once complete, B2N will deliver faster and more efficient travel while improving connections between the Sunshine Coast, Moreton Bay and Brisbane, creating lasting benefits for local communities and the region.
Why Join Seymour Whyte?
At Seymour Whyte, we believe the best way to learn is by doing. Our structured Graduate Development Program is designed to fast-track your career through hands-on project experience, mentoring from industry leaders and tailored professional development opportunities.
From day one, you'll be embedded in a live project team, contributing to the delivery of major infrastructure projects that shape communities across Australia. You'll gain exposure to a range of disciplines, build your technical and commercial acumen and develop the confidence to take ownership of meaningful work early in your career.
Throughout the program, you'll be supported by experienced mentors, participate in structured development workshops, and connect with a national network of graduates and professionals who are invested in your success.
What's in it for you?
- Work on a landmark civil infrastructure project from day one
- Gain exposure to multiple disciplines across project delivery
- Receive structured mentoring, coaching and development support
- Learn from experienced industry leaders and subject matter experts
- Build a strong professional network across projects and regions
- Be part of a collaborative, supportive and high-performing team culture
- Access career opportunities within the VINCI Group, a global leader in construction, infrastructure and concessions
Whether your passion lies in construction delivery, engineering, project management or leadership, our Graduate Development Program will provide the foundation, support and opportunities to help you build a rewarding and long-term career with Seymour Whyte.
To learn more about our Graduate Program, click here.
About You
You're in your final year of a Bachelor of Civil Engineering and ready to turn everything you've learned into real-world experience on major infrastructure projects.
Whether you've gained experience through an internship, vacation work, industry placement or part-time employment, you're eager to learn, build your skills and make a meaningful contribution from day one.
We're looking for graduates who are curious, motivated and excited about a career in civil construction.
You'll bring:
- Final-year studies in a Bachelor of Civil Engineering
- Practical experience through internships, vacation programs, placements or other employment
- A genuine passion for civil construction and infrastructure projects
- A positive attitude and willingness to learn from experienced industry professionals
- Strong communication and teamwork skills
- A commitment to safety, collaboration and creating a positive team culture
- Flexibility to travel or relocate as opportunities arise throughout your career
Most importantly, you're ready to take the next step, embrace new challenges and build a rewarding career delivering projects that make a lasting impact on communities across Australia.
Seymour Whyte Benefits
- Employee recognition and awards that celebrate contribution and achievement
- An employee share program, providing the opportunity to invest in the long-term success of the business
- Birthday leave, because celebrating life's milestones matters
- The option to purchase additional leave to support travel, study or personal commitments
- Fitness and wellbeing discounts through WHEREFIT (gym memberships, meal plans and fitness brands)
- Travel, retail, lifestyle and wellness discounts
- Workplace banking benefits and everyday financial savings through CommBank and Flare
Seymour Whyte is an Equal Opportunity Employer, and we encourage applications from candidates with diverse backgrounds, including veterans.
Our commitment to an equitable construction industry extends to an inclusive culture that embraces our differences and gives everyone the opportunity to grow and be equally valued. We're unified in our direction toward having a workplace that is balanced and fair for all.
Next Steps:
- Submit your CV online to apply for this role
- All successful applicants will be required to undergo a pre-employment medical and criminal history check
- Applications will only be accepted from candidates who have the right to work in Australia

candidates.content_text:
Build More. Build Your Career.
Ready to kick-start your engineering career on some of Southeast Queensland’s most exciting infrastructure projects?
Seymour Whyte's Graduate Program gives ambitious engineering graduates the opportunity to work on major projects, take on real responsibility from day one, and develop the technical, commercial and leadership skills needed for a successful career in construction.
Through our structured two-year development program, you'll gain hands-on experience across major civil infrastructure projects, work alongside industry leaders, receive dedicated mentoring and build the skills and confidence to accelerate your career.  You'll be trusted with real responsibility, supported to grow and given the opportunity to make a genuine impact while helping deliver infrastructure that connects communities.
If you're ready to learn, grow and help shape the future, we'd love to hear from you.
About the Project
We have an exciting opportunity for a Graduate Civil Engineer to join our Cressbrook Dam Safety Improvement Project, a major infrastructure upgrade that will strengthen the dam's flood capacity, improve resilience to extreme weather events and enhance long-term community safety.
This is a unique opportunity to gain hands-on experience on a complex and high-profile project while working alongside experienced industry professionals. You'll be exposed to a broad range of civil engineering disciplines and play a meaningful role in delivering infrastructure that will benefit local communities for generations to come.
Located in the picturesque Toowoomba region, this role offers the chance to build your career in a supportive project environment while enjoying the benefits of regional living.
The successful candidate will be required to work away from home, with attractive living away from home (LAFHA) and project allowances provided.
Why Join Seymour Whyte?
At Seymour Whyte, we believe the best way to learn is by doing. Our structured Graduate Development Program is designed to fast-track your career through hands-on project experience, mentoring from industry leaders and tailored professional development opportunities.
From day one, you'll be embedded in a live project team, contributing to the delivery of major infrastructure projects that shape communities across Australia. You'll gain exposure to a range of disciplines, build your technical and commercial acumen and develop the confidence to take ownership of meaningful work early in your career.
Throughout the program, you'll be supported by experienced mentors, participate in structured development workshops, and connect with a national network of graduates and professionals who are invested in your success.
What's in it for you?
- Work on a landmark civil infrastructure project from day one
- Gain exposure to multiple disciplines across project delivery
- Receive structured mentoring, coaching and development support
- Learn from experienced industry leaders and subject matter experts
- Build a strong professional network across projects and regions
- Be part of a collaborative, supportive and high-performing team culture
- Access career opportunities within the VINCI Group, a global leader in construction, infrastructure and concessions
Whether your passion lies in construction delivery, engineering, project management or leadership, our Graduate Development Program will provide the foundation, support and opportunities to help you build a rewarding and long-term career with Seymour Whyte.
To learn more about our Graduate Program, click here.
About You
You're in your final year of a Bachelor of Civil Engineering and ready to turn everything you've learned into real-world experience on major infrastructure projects.
Whether you've gained experience through an internship, vacation work, industry placement or part-time employment, you're eager to learn, build your skills and make a meaningful contribution from day one.
We're looking for graduates who are curious, motivated and excited about a career in civil construction.
You'll bring:
- Final-year studies in a Bachelor of Civil Engineering
- Practical experience through internships, vacation programs, placements or other employment
- A genuine passion for civil construction and infrastructure projects
- A positive attitude and willingness to learn from experienced industry professionals
- Strong communication and teamwork skills
- A commitment to safety, collaboration and creating a positive team culture
- Flexibility to travel or relocate as opportunities arise throughout your career
Most importantly, you're ready to take the next step, embrace new challenges and build a rewarding career delivering projects that make a lasting impact on communities across Australia.
Seymour Whyte Benefits
- Employee recognition and awards that celebrate contribution and achievement
- An employee share program, providing the opportunity to invest in the long-term success of the business
- Birthday leave, because celebrating life's milestones matters
- The option to purchase additional leave to support travel, study or personal commitments
- Fitness and wellbeing discounts through WHEREFIT (gym memberships, meal plans and fitness brands)
- Travel, retail, lifestyle and wellness discounts
- Workplace banking benefits and everyday financial savings through CommBank and Flare
Seymour Whyte is an Equal Opportunity Employer, and we encourage applications from candidates with diverse backgrounds, including veterans.
Our commitment to an equitable construction industry extends to an inclusive culture that embraces our differences and gives everyone the opportunity to grow and be equally valued. We're unified in our direction toward having a workplace that is balanced and fair for all.
Next Steps:
- Submit your CV online to apply for this role
- All successful applicants will be required to undergo a pre-employment medical and criminal history check
- Applications will only be accepted from candidates who have the right to work in Australia
To learn more about us, visit www.seymourwhyte.com.au

candidates.content_text:
D&J’s Civil Construction is a respected and growing civil construction company delivering high-quality civil infrastructure and subdivision projects across South East Queensland.
With a strong pipeline of work, we are looking for a Graduate Civil Engineer to join our team and develop their career alongside experienced engineers, supervisors and construction crews.
This is a great opportunity for a graduate who wants to get out on site, get hands-on experience and learn how civil construction actually works from the ground up.
The Role
Working closely with our Project Managers, Site Engineers and Supervisors, you will gain exposure to a variety of civil construction projects, including subdivisions, earthworks, stormwater, sewer, watermain and pipe installation works.
Your responsibilities will grow as your experience develops and may include:
- Assisting with day-to-day site management and coordination
- Reading and interpreting construction drawings and specifications
- Assisting with set-out, levels and grade checking
- Preparing and maintaining QA documentation, ITPs and checklists
- Completing daily diaries and site records
- Assisting with quantities, take-offs and material requirements
- Monitoring subcontractors, deliveries and site activities
- Assisting with project cost tracking and variations
- Liaising with supervisors, subcontractors, suppliers and clients
- Assisting with progress claims and project documentation
- Participating in toolbox meetings and site inspections
- Ensuring works are completed safely and in accordance with project requirements
- Learning the practical side of civil construction and developing into a confident Site Engineer
What We're Looking For
We are looking for someone who is keen to learn, reliable and ready to get stuck into the work.
You will ideally have:
- A Bachelor of Civil Engineering or be nearing completion
- Previous civil construction experience is advantageous
- A current Australian driver's licence
- White Card
- Good communication and organisational skills
- The ability to work as part of a team
- A practical, hands-on attitude
- Strong attention to detail
- A willingness to learn and take direction
- The ability to work in a fast-paced construction environment
Most importantly, we're looking for someone with the right attitude who wants to build a long-term career in civil construction.
Location: South East Queensland – work may be across Brisbane, Ipswich, Gold Coast and surrounding areas.
If you're a recent Civil Engineering graduate who wants to learn, get out on site and build a career in the civil construction industry, we'd love to hear from you.

candidates.content_text:
About Us
For over 35 years, GPA Engineering has been a trusted, Australian-owned consultancy delivering engineering, procurement and construction management services across water, energy, renewables, defence, mining, and hydrogen. We develop and implement projects that drive critical infrastructure and support industries across Australia.
With offices nationwide (Adelaide, Brisbane, Melbourne, Sydney, Darwin, Perth) and a reputation for technical excellence, our strength lies in our people. We bring together diverse, motivated professionals who value teamwork, integrity, safety, and sustainability. At GPA, you’ll find the scale and expertise of a leading consultancy, combined with the supportive culture of a close-knit team.
About the Role
With a strong pipeline of projects across the energy, resources and industrial sectors, GPA Engineering is seeking an experienced Civil/Structural Drafter to join our Adelaide team.
Based in our Adelaide Head Office, you will work as part of a multidisciplinary team delivering projects across oil & gas, mining, materials handling, water and power. This role is suited to someone with 3-10 years' experience who enjoys variety, technical challenges and developing high-quality 2D drawings and 3D models.
Working closely with engineers and designers, you'll contribute to projects from concept through to detailed design, gaining exposure to a broad range of clients and industries. You'll have the opportunity to further develop your drafting and modelling skills while taking increasing ownership of design documentation and model coordination.
Key Duties:
 - Prepare, revise and maintain civil and structural engineering drawings and 3D models across a range of projects.
 - Produce high-quality 2D deliverables including general arrangements, plans, elevations, sections and construction details.
 - Develop and maintain 3D models to support coordinated multidisciplinary project delivery.
 - Work closely with engineers and designers to translate engineering concepts and calculations into clear and practical design documentation.
 - Apply relevant Australian Standards, client specifications, project requirements and GPA drafting standards.
 - Participate in drawing and model reviews and incorporate design changes and review comments.
 - Coordinate with other engineering disciplines to identify and resolve design interfaces and clashes.
 - Manage assigned drafting activities to meet project schedules and agreed deliverables.
 - Ensure drawings, models and associated documentation comply with GPA quality assurance requirements
We are looking for a collaborative and technically capable Civil/Structural Drafter with strong attention to detail and a practical approach to engineering documentation.
The successful candidate will ideally have:
 - Qualifications: An Associate Degree in Civil and Structural Engineering (Design Drafting), Advanced Diploma or equivalent recognised drafting/design qualification, either completed or currently being undertaken.
 - Experience: Approximately 3–10 years of relevant civil and/or structural drafting and design experience earthworks.
 - Industry Experience: Experience in heavy industry sectors such as oil & gas, mining, materials handling, water or power will be highly regarded.
 - 2D Drafting: Strong capability in producing engineering drawings including general arrangements, plans, elevations, sections and construction details.
 - 3D Modelling: Experience developing and working with 3D models as part of coordinated engineering project delivery.
 - Software: Proficiency in AutoCAD and/or MicroStation. Experience with Civil 3D, Advance Steel, Revit or other relevant design and modelling software would be advantageous.
 - Technical Understanding: Ability to interpret engineering mark-ups, design information, relevant Australian Standards and client specifications.
 - Quality: Strong attention to detail and an understanding of engineering drawing standards, document control and QA processes.
 - Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively both independently and within multidisciplinary project teams.
A requirement for this role is to complete a satisfactory pre-employment medical check and Australian police clearance. 
At GPA, we want our people to thrive both professionally and personally. We’re big enough to deliver complex, high-profile projects, yet small enough that you’ll be known, valued and supported.
 - Competitive Salary & Rewards – an attractive remuneration package, including paid overtime, recognising the value of the work you put in.
 - Career Growth & Development – structured career progression, company-sponsored training, mentoring and support towards professional membership and Chartership.
 - Diverse Project Exposure – opportunities to work across different industries, clients and project types, building broad technical and practical experience.
 - Flexibility – hybrid working options and cultural leave swap days, supporting a healthy balance between work and life.
 - Health & Wellbeing – wellbeing programs, confidential EAP support and a workplace culture that looks out for its people.
 - Family-Friendly Benefits – paid parental leave for primary and secondary carers, together with policies designed to support different stages of life.
 - Community & Culture – opportunities to connect beyond project work through sporting and fitness groups, social events, family BBQs, quiz nights and celebrations of diverse cultural traditions.
 - Giving Back – a strong commitment to the community, with GPA having donated more than $3 million directly to charitable organisations.
 - Diversity & Inclusion – a workplace where different perspectives are respected and collaboration is encouraged.
At GPA, we offer a supportive working environment where people can build long-term careers. More than 80 of our team members have been with GPA for over 10 years, reflecting the opportunities, culture and stability we aim to provide.
Hear from our people and learn more about working at GPA through our Careers page (https://www.gpaeng.com.au/careers/).
GPA is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applications from people of all backgrounds and experiences.
How to Apply
Submit your applications through our online recruitment system before EOD 30th October 2026.
If you require adjustments to the recruitment process to support your application, you may email us at HR@gpaeng.com.au.

We will not be held liable for any fees or claims from recruitment agencies regarding unsolicited resumes or candidate submissions. We appreciate your understanding and cooperation.

candidates.content_text:
Location: Sydney, NSW
Employment Type: Full-Time
We are seeking a motivated and reliable Junior Civil Engineer to join our growing construction team, specialising in retaining wall design and construction.
This is an excellent opportunity for a recent Civil Engineering graduate or junior engineer looking to develop their skills across geotechnical engineering, retaining wall design and construction, while gaining practical site experience on projects across Sydney.
About the Role
Working closely with our Project Managers, Site Supervisors and construction team, you will assist with the design, planning, coordination and delivery of retaining wall projects from commencement through to completion.
Your responsibilities will include:
- Assisting with the design and engineering of retaining walls
- Assisting with geotechnical assessments and engineering calculations
- Using PLAXIS for geotechnical modelling and analysis
- Assisting with stability analysis and retaining wall design
- Reviewing engineering drawings, plans and project specifications
- Assisting with site set-out, levels, measurements and inspections
- Monitoring construction activities and progress on site
- Assisting with design changes and technical queries during construction
- Preparing and maintaining engineering and construction documentation
- Assisting with ITPs, QA/QC documentation and project records
- Assisting with quantities, material take-offs and progress claims
- Checking construction works against approved drawings and specifications
- Liaising with project managers, supervisors, subcontractors, consultants and suppliers
- Identifying engineering and construction issues and assisting with practical solutions
- Assisting with technical documentation, reports and project correspondence
- Maintaining a strong focus on safety, quality and compliance
About You
The ideal candidate will have:
- A Civil Engineering degree or relevant qualification
- 0–3 years' experience in civil or structural construction/engineering
- A strong interest in retaining wall design and geotechnical engineering
- PLAXIS experience and an understanding of geotechnical modelling
- Knowledge of retaining wall design principles and stability analysis
- Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings and specifications
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
- Excellent attention to detail
- Good communication and organisational skills
- A practical understanding of construction methodologies
- Ability to work independently and as part of a construction team
- Current Australian driver's licence
- White Card
Desirable Experience
Experience or knowledge in the following will be highly regarded:
- PLAXIS 2D / PLAXIS 3D
- Geotechnical engineering
- Retaining wall design
- Soil and foundation behaviour
- Slope and global stability analysis
- Reinforced concrete retaining walls
- Cantilever and gravity retaining walls
- Temporary and permanent retaining structures
- Australian Standards and relevant engineering specifications
- Civil construction and site engineering
What We Offer
- Full-time position with an established construction company
- Hands-on experience across retaining wall design and construction
- Exposure to both engineering and construction aspects of projects
- Opportunity to develop your geotechnical and PLAXIS skills
- Mentoring and support from experienced engineering and construction professionals
- Career progression and professional development
- Variety of retaining wall projects across Sydney
- Competitive salary based on experience and qualifications
Apply Now
If you're a motivated Junior Civil Engineer looking to develop your career in retaining wall design, geotechnical engineering and construction, we'd like to hear from you.
Please submit your resume through SEEK.
